lines.trans: Tanya, and where did your former husband disappear to?
He tragically died very many years ago.
What exactly happened with him then, tell me?
Remember, a large barge sank on Sineye Lake?
Of course I remember, that was fifteen years ago.
In that terrible accident many people died.
Lyonya and I were sailing on it then.
The barge suddenly hit something and began to sink.
Among frightened passengers a terrible panic began.
There were not enough life buoys for all people.
Lyonya quickly threw a wooden pallet into cold water.
He placed me onto this raft alone.
He is a true hero for having saved your life.
Yes, but he himself drowned in the water.
